Ivy N: Wrapping up the kv-eviction postmortem follow-ups. We promised a) a regression harness that runs at night and a quick CI smoke, b) an incident-derived promptset for evals, c) a short load test for cold-cache scenarios, and d) a 30-minute chaos drill to rehearse fallback and rollback. Need owners and dates.
Carlos P: I can take the nightly regression harness + alert gate. Plan: 10m cold-cache run with 70k keys, assert eviction_rate < 0.02 and TTL_stability delta < 0.01. Will open PR by Fri.
Mina S: I9ll own the promptset. I want to extract 18 prompts from the incident transcript: 10 critical, 8 fuzz/edge cases (truncation, hallucination, soft-response). I9ll include golden JSON outputs and a tiny scorer that emits pass/fail. ETA: next Wed.
Liam O: I9ll add a k6-based load test that we can run in CI on merges to staging-routing to exercise cold-cache churn and long-tail reads. Will also add a teardown step that validates eviction metrics and cleans test keys. Spike today, PR tomorrow morning.
Ivy N: Also want an automated gate rule: if nightly eviction_rate > 0.025 for two consecutive runs, auto-create a ticket in Jira and ping #incidents and the oncall rotation.
ci-bot: Note: CI job must tag runs with env=staging-inference and metrics_namespace=kv.cache. Include upload of metrics.json artifact.
Carlos P: Proposed nightly cron: run at 02:15 UTC, uses the harness ./tests/kv_nightly_run.sh --keys 70000 --duration 600, then compute eviction_rate via ./tools/compute_eviction.py. If eviction_rate > 0.02 -> fail and create ticket.
Mina S: For promptset scoring, plan two tiers: critical prompts require exact-match against canonical JSON, tolerant prompts use a fuzzy matcher (Jaccard > 0.7). I9ll add documentation of expected behavior per prompt.
Liam O: CI job snippet I9ll add to infra/.github/workflows/k6_kv_smoke.yaml:
```yaml
jobs:
  kv_k6_smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run k6 cold-cache script
        run: k6 run --vus 50 --duration 3m tests/k6/kv_cold_cache.js
      - name: Fetch eviction metric
        run: ./tools/fetch_metric.sh kv.cache.eviction_rate --output evict.json
      - name: Fail on threshold
        run: if [ $(jq .eviction_rate evict.json) > 0.025 ]; then echo "eviction too high" && exit 2; fi
```
Ivy N: Good. For the chaos drill, I want to rehearse two scenarios in a single 30-minute window: 1) regional routing overload -> verify automated fallback to smaller model variant and route to secondary region, 2) sustained cold-cache pressure -> validate that regression job + CI gates detect before degradation hits prod. We need a short playbook with step-by-step commands and rollback triggers.
Carlos P: I9ll add a gating check to create an immediate rollback ticket if eviction spikes during the drill. Also will add a runbook entry for how to toggle the routing policy and model variant via the control-plane API.
Mina S: I9ll include the two prompt examples that historically produced truncation and hallucinated entities and mark the expected fail modes so SRE knows what to look for during the drill.
Liam O: I9ll prep the k6 scenario plus a small script to inject synthetic key churn and then validate metrics. Will also put a flag to run the job against staging-routing and staging-inference clusters.

Ivy N: Action items (from this thread):
- Carlos: nightly regression harness, gate + auto-ticket (PR Fri)
- Mina: promptset (18 prompts) + scorer + docs (PR Wed)
- Liam: k6 CI load test + teardown/verify (PR tomorrow morning)
- Ivy: draft the 30-min playbook and confirm drill slot with oncall
Post PR links here so we can validate before the drill. If something slips, call it out in this thread. :mag: 
Carlos P: Will ping when PR is ready.
Mina S: Starting transcript extraction now; will post a draft promptset in the docs repo today.
Liam O: Spiking now, will paste initial k6 run logs and artifact links here.
Ivy N: Thanks team. We'll do a 20-min pre-drill validation once PRs are merged. If any owner needs help, tag me or the oncall. :white_check_mark:
